body: Wave 1 shipped as 7 draft PRs against feat/composer-editor-core, all MERGEABLE, every gate verdict pass (0 inert, 0 inconclusive):U+000AU+002D #212 screen-reader-musts (4 pass), #213 reminders (8), #214 composer-focus (4), #215 capture-cleanup (8), #216 editor-input (9), #217 media (2), #218 photo-placement (7; landed by held + --resume after my 11 assertion updates).U+000AReconcile: only #218 has undeclared writes (the 5 test files I edited, no other owner). Unwritten declared files were all conditional or covered: composer-focus refocus reaches edit-note and log viewer through ComposerGuard; the IME fix is in delta_mirror.dart (declared), matching the root cause; reminders' settings tests only needed edits where fields are enumerated; photo import/drop call the rewritten stop functions. Both native notification-settings handlers (MainActivity.kt, MainFlutterWindow.swift) are in #213. editor-input's formatter churn stayed out (no undeclared writes).U+000ACI on the PRs runs only goldens, receipts and pr-title-lint, not flutter test; a local merge of all 7 branches (scratchpad/wave1-merge, unsigned throwaway merges, never pushed) merged cleanly and is running analyze + the full suite.
